propositions: Allowlisted read-only tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) must be wrapped with a memoization layer that caches results by signature and returns the cached result without re-executing on duplicate calls.
Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)', '(empty)', and '(empty range)' must be memoized and trigger escalating static nudge lines to steer the model away from repeated queries.
Error results prefixed with 'Error:' must NOT be memoized and must re-execute on retry to allow for transient outcome changes.

The memoization wrapper must be positioned at the agent-call seam in agent_call.py with strict ordering: runaway guard (outermost) → memoization → steering, such that the guard observes all duplicates for distinct-ratio accounting.
Nudge escalation must use byte-stable static templated text: first repeat receives level-1 nudge, subsequent repeats receive level-2 escalation, both consistent across runs for prompt caching.
Write and non-deterministic tools like record_criterion_verdict must never be memoized and must always execute normally.
